en: Black-and-white postcard showing a panoramic view of a German town with many tightly packed houses, church spires on the left, and a castle-like complex with towers and surrounding parkland on the right. In the lower part, a decorative frame with a laurel wreath and lyre emblem contains German text and a ribbon announcing a singers' festival in Waldenburg, Saxony, dated June 13–14, 1908.
